mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE status = 1) AS pending, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE severity = 3) AS severe, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE create_time >= CURRENT_DATE) AS today FROM qa_alert WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_alert (id, tenant_code, session_id, session_no, agent_id, message_id, message_seq, rule_id, rule_name, rule_type, severity, hit_keyword, snippet, advice, status, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantCode}, #{sessionId}, #{sessionNo}, #{agentId}, #{messageId}, #{messageSeq}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleName}, #{ruleType}, #{severity}, #{hitKeyword}, #{snippet}, #{advice}, 1, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{creator}, #{editor}, FALSE) ON CONFLICT (tenant_code, message_id, rule_id) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
